newsitem.title: USA: ACT Networks wins $2.0 mln Comsat order.
newsitem.headline: ACT Networks wins $2.0 mln Comsat order.

text.p: ACT Networks Inc said it has won $2.0 million in new orders from Comsat do Brazil worth approximately $2 million for "a few hundred units" of ACT's CS-9500 NetPeformer.
The orders, to be shipped during the December quarter, will be used by Comsat to provide integrated satellite network services to a number of large customers.
"We believe Comsat's success is evidence of the growing demand for advanced satellite-based, frame-relay network solutions," said Martin Shum, chief executive.
ACT shares closed up 2-1/2 at 26-3/4 in Thursday trading.
